topic: Conditionals 0, 1 and 2 with unless, as long as, provided, in case
intro: Qoida: if gapida "will" ishlatilmaydi: If it rains, we will stay home (not "if it will rain"). Zero conditional (if + present, present) umumiy haqiqat uchun, first conditional (if + present, will) real kelajak uchun, second conditional (if + past, would) xayoliy vaziyat uchun: If I were you, I would apologise. "Unless" = "if not", shuning uchun ikki marta inkor qilinmaydi: Unless you hurry, you'll miss it. "In case" ehtimoldan ehtiyot bo'lish uchun (take an umbrella in case it rains), "if" esa shart uchun.
title: Conditionals 0, 1 and 2 with unless, as long as, provided, in case · test

topic: Conditionals 0, 1 and 2 with unless, as long as, provided, in case
intro: Qoida: if gapida "will" ishlatilmaydi: If it rains, we will stay home (not "if it will rain"). Zero conditional (if + present, present) umumiy haqiqat uchun, first conditional (if + present, will) real kelajak uchun, second conditional (if + past, would) xayoliy vaziyat uchun: If I were you, I would apologise. "Unless" = "if not", shuning uchun ikki marta inkor qilinmaydi: Unless you hurry, you'll miss it. "In case" ehtimoldan ehtiyot bo'lish uchun (take an umbrella in case it rains), "if" esa shart uchun.

topic: Gerund or infinitive: verbs that change meaning
intro: Qoida: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing va to + infinitive ishlatiladi, lekin ma'no o'zgaradi. "Stop doing" - to'xtatish (He stopped smoking), "stop to do" - maqsad bilan to'xtash (He stopped to buy bread). "Remember / forget / regret + -ing" o'tmishdagi ishga, "+ to do" esa bajariladigan ishga tegishli: I remember locking the door, Remember to lock the door. "Try doing" - sinab ko'rish, "try to do" - urinish; "go on doing" - davom etish, "go on to do" - keyingi bosqichga o'tish; "mean doing" - degani, "mean to do" - niyat qilish; "need doing" - passiv ma'no (The car needs washing).
title: Gerund or infinitive: verbs that change meaning · test

topic: Gerund or infinitive: verbs that change meaning
intro: Qoida: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing va to + infinitive ishlatiladi, lekin ma'no o'zgaradi. "Stop doing" - to'xtatish (He stopped smoking), "stop to do" - maqsad bilan to'xtash (He stopped to buy bread). "Remember / forget / regret + -ing" o'tmishdagi ishga, "+ to do" esa bajariladigan ishga tegishli: I remember locking the door, Remember to lock the door. "Try doing" - sinab ko'rish, "try to do" - urinish; "go on doing" - davom etish, "go on to do" - keyingi bosqichga o'tish; "mean doing" - degani, "mean to do" - niyat qilish; "need doing" - passiv ma'no (The car needs washing).
title: Gerund or infinitive: verbs that change meaning · to'ldirish

intro: Qoida: although, though va even though dan keyin to'liq gap keladi (Although it rained, we went out), despite va in spite of dan keyin esa ot yoki -ing (Despite the rain; in spite of being tired); "despite of" xato. Because + gap, because of + ot. So that va in order to maqsadni bildiradi, in case ehtimol bo'lgan holatga tayyorgarlikni, if esa shartni. Otherwise va unless "aks holda / agar ...masa" ma'nosida; as a result va therefore natijani bildiradi. Kelishuvda: So do I (men ham), Neither have I (men ham yo'q), yordamchi fe'l oldingi gapga mos bo'ladi.

intro: Qoida: although, though va even though dan keyin to'liq gap keladi (Although it rained, we went out), despite va in spite of dan keyin esa ot yoki -ing (Despite the rain; in spite of being tired); "despite of" xato. Because + gap, because of + ot. So that va in order to maqsadni bildiradi, in case ehtimol bo'lgan holatga tayyorgarlikni, if esa shartni. Otherwise va unless "aks holda / agar ...masa" ma'nosida; as a result va therefore natijani bildiradi. Kelishuvda: So do I (men ham), Neither have I (men ham yo'q), yordamchi fe'l oldingi gapga mos bo'ladi.
title: Linking words and contrast · to'ldirish
